about: Corrections to the original project lists, reviewed 2026-10-01: a rename gives the released title; a removal takes out an entry that is not a released game on that system (rumours, prototypes, homebrew, DLC and updates, re-releases on newer consoles, games on another system or arcade board, duplicates, titles that do not exist), with the reason. Every entry IGDB could not confirm on its system was checked; IGDB data and the reviewer agreed on each removal. Ids never change.
